title: plant-genomics-mcp: 50 plant-genomics locus-lookup tools over 23 public backends via the Model Context Protocol
description: A plant-genomics server for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) providing 50 tools for locus lookup across 23 free, public backends — including Ensembl Plants, Phytozome BioMart, UniProtKB, Europe PMC, QuickGO, Planteome, PlantCyc/PMN, g:Profiler, NCBI BLAST, Gramene, JASPAR, KEGG, STRING-DB, ATTED-II, ThaleMine, and the Bio-Analytic Resource for Plant Biology (BAR). Covers single-locus lookup, motif and region queries, variant annotation, gene-set enrichment, BLAST search, parallel batch retrieval, and cross-source synthesis, over stdio and Streamable-HTTP transports.
